structure_map.reason: Cys61 is a zinc-coordinating cysteine in the RING-type zinc finger (UniProt Zinc finger 24-65); in the AlphaFold model its sulfur converges with C39 (3.68 Angstrom) and C64 (3.67 Angstrom) on a buried anchor. C61G is annotated pathogenic and abolishes BAP1 interaction (UniProt Natural variant at 61; dbSNP rs28897672). Resolved from ClinVar VCV000017661 on 2026-07-21.
